118314.name: Chabad of St. Louis Park
118314.note: CrownHeights.info (28 Dec 2020, 'Mikvah.org: Meet Our Presenters'): 'Rabbi Dr. Yosef Shagalow is a Rav and Shliach in Minnesota since 1986.' The English Chabadpedia (chabadpedia.com, 'Yosef Yitzchok Shagalov (Minnesota)', read by Firecrawl's research agent; it does not open here): after his marriage 'he went out in 5746 (1985-86) to serve as the Rebbe's shliach in Minneapolis, Minnesota, and founded a Chabad House there.' Medium: neither names the center; he is this listing's director. Dr. Yosef Y. Shagalow's Chabad of St. Louis Park at 2834 Raleigh Avenue in the Dec 2009 lubavitch.com directory (Wayback); today's listing shows no street. Its chabad.org listing is in the first online directory (listings published July 22 2004), so it existed by then. Its listing names Rabbi Yehuda Shurpin with Dr. Shagalow.

118494.name: Chabad V.s.L. & Chabad Bois Franc
118494.note: No founding report found (Nov 9 first pass: CrownHeights.info and lubavitch.com searched by name and director, and a web search). Quebec enterprise register (Registraire des entreprises, open data 'Registre des entreprises', file of Nov 1 2026): 'CHABAD OF VILLE ST-LAURENT' is a name of Montreal Chabad's umbrella corporation, 'L'ORGANISATION DE LA JEUNESSE CHABAD LOUBAVITCH' / 'CHABAD LUBAVITCH YOUTH ORGANIZATION' (NEQ 1143241058, a religious corporation constituted May 1 1973, 3429 Peel Street) from the register's start (March 6 1995) until 2013, so the center existed by then; its own corporation 'LE CENTRE CHABAD VILLE ST-LAURENT' (NEQ 1165397309) was constituted Sept 10 2008 ('Centre Chabad VSL' and 'Centre Chabad Bois-Franc' added 2024). Its chabad.org listing is in the first online directory (listings published July 22 2004), so it existed by then. Director: Schneur Silberstein. Kosher Delight's Quebec Chabad directory (entry 'Updated on: October 23, 2007'): 'Chabad House V.s.L. & Chabad Bois Franc, 790 Marcel Laurin, Ville S. Laurent, QC H4M 2M6', Rabbi Schneur Zalman Silberstein; by Sept 2010 its site gives 854 Fraser Street (a move).

earlier.where: 790 Marcel Laurin, Ville St-Laurent (Kosher Delight's directory, entry updated Oct 23 2007)

118188.name: Chabad Lubavitch of Oregon
118188.note: CrownHeights.info, 8 Aug 2023: 'Chabad of Oregon was founded in 1984 when Rabbi Moshe and Devora Wilhelm moved to the city with two of their young children to establish Chabad-Lubavitch of Oregon.' CrownHeights.info, 5 Apr 2017, says the same: 'when the senior Wilhelms arrived in 1984'. Jewish Federation of Greater Portland (24 Jan 2020): 'Thirty-six years ago Rabbi Moshe Wilhelm and family arrived in Portland in January 1984 ... and Chabad of Oregon was founded' (the month kept).
